en: Sepia-toned photographic portrait of a young woman with long wavy hair adorned with flowers, gazing slightly upward in a devotional pose with hands clasped. At the top right is printed text identifying her as Magdalena Seebe in the role of "Undine." The lower left has the studio imprint "HAHN NACHF. Dresden. 671." The front is heavily inscribed in dark ink with a handwritten German message and signature, dated 1.4.16.
